methodology: Cadence-aware source health. Status is based on each official source's observation date and normal release cadence, not the dashboard collection/check time. Collection success and observation freshness are intentionally separate concepts.
sec_runner_note: SEC N-PORT bulk downloads may return HTTP 403 from GitHub-hosted runners. When that happens, the last-good verified cache is retained and the limitation is surfaced rather than represented as fresh data.
